messages:
Sam (AE): Heads up — Emberwell Health needs an executive readout and PO by COB Fri or they'll pause the POC. Key asks: dedicated pool within 10 days, KMS with import, and a 3-month egress waiver. Can we escalate?
Priya (SE): I can lead the tech one-pager. Main constraints: HSM-backed keys vs KMS import — we can support KMS with Bring-Your-Own-Key but HSM import is Private-only and takes time. Also need their qps & average tokens to size the pool.
Tomas (Eng): If we use Dedicated (reserved pool) we can stand up nodes faster if ops approves capacity reassign. Typical lead time without reallocation is ~3 weeks. With emergency allocation maybe 7-10 days. Need written PO to start.
Avery (Security): Emberwell asked for SOC2 evidence, network peering diagram, and a KMS attestation. We have SOC2 link: https://redwood.example/soc2.pdf. We can provide redacted pen test summary. HSM attestation? Not in scope for quick turnaround.
Sam (AE): Sales exec wants a succinct internal escalation note for leadership: problem, ask, risk, and proposed concession. @Marcus what's our flexibility on discount / concessions?
Marcus (VP Sales): If this is strategic, we can offer a 3-month egress waiver and up to 15% ACV concession to close this quarter. Need SE to confirm cost fallback plan so we don't leave ourselves exposed.
Priya (SE): Cost mitigation plan: enable prefix/KV caching, recommend 8-bit quantized model variant, and reserve a small burst pool. That combo reduces expected infra cost by ~25-35% depending on traffic. I need expected qps/tokens.
Sam (AE): I asked the customer for qps + avg tokens. They replied: peak 120 qps, avg tokens per call 250.
Tomas (Eng): With 120 peak qps and 250 tokens average, we need ~6 GPUs for steady throughput with target p99 < 300ms on gen-2 model. If we allocate spare capacity we can do 10-day target. Ops will need signoff.
Priya (SE): Drafting the one-pager now. Will include: sizing, fallback to quantized model, KV prefix caching, estimated monthly cost (reserved vs burst), and required customer deliverables (PO + network details).
Legal (Counsel): Quick note re: egress waiver — Finance needs a written concession in the SOW with defined timebox (3 months) and rollback terms. Also need to loop legal for KMS language (can't promise key custodial changes without risk review).
Marcus (VP Sales): Understood. I can approve the 3-month waiver and 15% discount pending SE risk numbers. Sam, prepare an exec note and attach the draft SOW concession clause.
Sam (AE): Will do. Priya — can you drop the one-pager here by 4pm PT? Leadership wants it before their 5pm sync.
Priya (SE): Yep — aiming for 15:30 PT with cost sims and a short perf table.
DeployBot: Deployment request queued: ticket #38012 — note: capacity reallocation requires finance approval.
Tomas (Eng): Confirming — ops can shift the pool within 10 days if leadership approves reallocation and we get PO today. Otherwise default 3 weeks.
Sam (AE): Customer emailed: "If Redwood can confirm dedicated pool within 10 days and waive egress for 3 months we will sign PO today."
Marcus (VP Sales): Ok — I'm greenlighting emergency reallocation contingent on PO + signoff. Sam, get me the one-pager + SOW concession draft; I will escalate to the weekly leadership call.
Priya (SE): One-pager uploaded: https://drive.redwood/emberwell-tech-onepager — includes perf table, fallback plan, and cost delta for quantization + caching.
Avery (Security): I added security caveats and required artifacts (SOC2 pdf, network diagram, minimal data retention statement). Sent to Legal for SOW wording.
Legal (Counsel): Draft concession language posted in thread. Key lines: "Egress waiver for 3 months for POC environment only; normal egress pricing resumes thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing."
Sam (AE): Sharing with customer now.
Sam (AE): Customer responded: "We can sign immediately with the 3-month waiver and the dedicated pool ETA of 10 business days." They attached a PO draft.
Marcus (VP Sales): Great. Sam, transfer PO to finance and cc me. Tomas, start the ops ticket after finance confirms. Priya, stand by for any final config asks.
Tomas (Eng): Will prepare deployment runbook. If we use emergency capacity we may impact internal dev environments — calling it out as a risk.
Priya (SE): Noted. I'll include rollback plan and perf regression test checklist in the runbook.
Sam (AE): Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. I will post a short exec summary after I hear back from Finance. :thumbsup:
Marcus (VP Sales): Thanks everyone — pushing to close this week.
Avery (Security): Leave a note for post-PO security checklist: KMS integration timeline, network peering checklist, and audit log delivery.
Sam (AE): Final internal ask: capture the concession in SOW draft and get signoff from Finance + Legal by EOD tomorrow. I'll update leadership after signoff.
